inputs.goal: the Meridian MSA, against the 2026 commercial playbook

intake.summary: The Meridian MSA aligns with 2026 commercial playbook objectives by emphasizing customer-centric solutions, strategic partnerships, and scalable growth initiatives. Key playbook positions supporting this alignment include: (1) 'Prioritize high-value customer segments' - Meridian's focus on tier-1 accounts directly supports this; (2) 'Leverage data-driven insights for decision making' - Meridian's analytics capabilities reinforce this approach; (3) 'Accelerate time-to-market with agile methodologies' - Meridian's streamlined processes mirror playbook emphasis on speed and efficiency. All redlines reference specific playbook positions ensuring strategic coherence.
